pages.summary: Documented confirmed biome-region adoption through Edit World and removed the issue-based missing-feature ledger. Tightened the capability index and limits heading.
Converted the introduction into concise usage and snapshot rules. Checked every class/tag pair against the class registry.
Removed port comparisons and regression-test details while retaining proposal validation, transaction scope and immediate-operation limits.
Removed fork-decision commentary while preserving notification ordering and weak-change opt-in behavior.
Removed temporal wording from the factory-selection rule and checked the registration contract against hook documentation.

Separated experience and explosion usage and corrected native panic behavior: explosion callback failures are reported and removal continues, whereas experience callback panics unwind before the answer is applied.
